CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_office_jobs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      shop TEXT,
      question TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      provider TEXT NOT NULL,
      selection_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
      context_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
      result TEXT,
      error TEXT,
      approved_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      started_at TEXT,
      finished_at TEXT
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_office_conversation_names (
      created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      root_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(created_by, root_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_office_pins (
      created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      root_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      PRIMARY KEY(created_by, root_id)
    )

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_office_jobs_owner_time
      ON ai_office_jobs(created_by, created_at DESC)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_office_jobs_status
      ON ai_office_jobs(status, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_office_worker_heartbeat (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_office_machines (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      providers_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_office_commands (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, machine_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', outcome TEXT, error TEXT, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, sent_at INTEGER, finished_at INTEGER)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_office_commands_machine ON ai_office_commands(machine_id, status)
ALTER TABLE ai_office_commands ADD COLUMN result_json TEXT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_office_events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_seq TEXT, event_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(job_id,event_seq))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_office_events_job ON ai_office_events(job_id,id)

    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_office_inputs_job ON ai_office_inputs(job_id,status)
